title: SimLab: Cooja simulation metrics for multi-objective WSN topology optimisation
description:
Per-node network metric samples and Cooja log residues from 41 multi-objective optimisation experiments run with SimLab, a platform that evaluates wireless sensor network topologies by simulating them in Cooja/Contiki-NG.

Contents. metrics/ holds one Parquet file per experiment: every per-node metric sample emitted during every simulation, in chronological order, with the simulation id, the Cooja timestamp (t_us, where the log generation recorded it) and the mote index as columns. logs/ holds, per experiment, a zstd-compressed tar of what remains of each Cooja log once the sample records are removed: boot banner, RPL parent changes and reachability probes. manifest.json carries counts, byte sizes and a SHA-256 for every file.

How it was derived. The database stored, per simulation, a full Cooja log and a CSV of metric samples. The CSV was exactly the log's sample records permuted (grouped by node rather than chronological), so the samples were extracted from the log — which additionally carries the timestamp and mote prefix the CSV drops — and the CSV is not carried over. Sorting a Parquet file by node reproduces the original CSV row for row.

What is not here. The complete Cooja logs, the per-simulation .csc and .pos inputs, topology images and pre-rendered analysis charts were not preserved. The experiment records themselves — configurations, Pareto fronts, individuals, objectives and DODAG trees — are in the companion repository.
